research_description_en: We conduct research on the reliability and security of world-model-based agents in local simulated environments. The Goal-Bus project examines whether changing preference-only goal metadata, while holding the physical state and complete executed action sequence fixed, changes forecasts and downstream planning decisions. We seek assistance with source-code review, reproducible controlled evaluation, statistical analysis, and defensive isolation or integrity checks. We distinguish a model's instruction-isolation contract from legitimate goal-conditioned prediction under partial observability. Any claim of decision harm must use simulator replay or independently observed consequences, rather than forecast divergence alone. Our scope is limited to systems and assets we own or are authorized to assess. Please review the appropriate Trusted Access offering and product access for this research workflow.

research_claim_boundary: Goal dependence alone is not evidence of physical prediction error or decision harm. The existing specification separates physical intervention invariance, partial-observation conditioning and model-specific instruction isolation.
